term.title: η

definitions.text: An affix giving a topological indication of the bonding between a $\ce{\uppi\!\mbox{-}electron}$ ligand and the central atom in a coordination entity. A right superscript numerical index indicates the number of ligating atoms in the $\ce{\uppi\!\mbox{-}electron}$ system of the ligand which bind to the central atom.
seealso: PAC, 1994, 66, 1077. 'Glossary of terms used in physical organic chemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 1994)' on page 1120 (https://doi.org/10.1351/pac199466051077)
